## Why

SIG's public and internal evaluation claims must stop implying an
independent human check that never happened. Until this row, camera-site
tiers 3–5 (identity inferences, not derivations) could auto-write on the
strength of an agent-labelled gold set — and agent labels were being
carried as if they measured human estimands. This row makes the posture
honest end to end: ruleset **v3-interim** demotes every inferential tier
to review-only unless a B5 independent-human evaluation certifies it
(none exists in Round 11 — ADR-152/153); the evaluator reports every
human estimand `unavailable` rather than silently substituting agent
evidence; GQ-24 and GQ-27 move to `enforce`; the gold set's provenance
says `agent` — including that both labelling runs were the same model;
and the one append-only ER re-run that applies v3-interim on the hosted
spine is engineered, guarded and queued behind its window and three
`live:` edges.

## What ships

- **Ruleset v3-interim** (`resolution/.../camera_site_rules.toml` +
  `camera_sites.py`): `candidate_auto_write = [1]`, `inferential =
  [3,4,5]`. Only the tier-1 namespace/derivation joins
  (`1g:shared_upstream_ref` & co.) remain auto-write eligible; every
  inferential candidate is recorded with basis + distance and routed to
  review with the demotion reason
  `review_only:inferential_tier_uncertified`. A measured precision
  shortfall stays the distinct `tier_not_auto_write`; a certification
  lookup that finds nothing reports `no_certifying_evaluation`; a B5
  certification naming the tier is the only escape hatch.
- **Honest evaluator** (`resolution/.../evaluator.py` + `quality_gates.py`):
  basis classes `human | agent | llm | synthetic | unknown | mixed |
  none`; human estimands consume `reference_provenance = 'human'`
  only — with no human labels they report `unavailable`
  (`no_human_reference` / `no_reference_clusters` / `no_recall_frame` /
  `no_cluster_frame`) and agent evidence is never substituted;
  `DemotionDecision` carries the classified `reason`.
- **Committed report** (`scripts/eval/run_honest_eval_posture.py` →
  `docs/build/reports/2026-10-09_honest_evaluation_posture.md`):
  deterministic regeneration; every human estimand `unavailable`, every
  figure basis-labelled — it attaches to P35.63's Class S readout; this
  row publishes nothing.
- **Gold-set provenance relabel** (`camera_site_gold.json`, additive):
  `provenance: agent`, `labeller_kind`, `labeller_model`,
  `labeller_runs_same_model: true` (both claude-opus-5-5) + a versioned
  re-stamp entry — byte-identical pairs, **no new adjudication**;
  `gold_set_rules.toml`'s κ comment now says the seed is a
  maintainer/agent label, never a human estimand.
- **GQ-24 + GQ-27 → `enforce`** (`quality_checks.toml` + `ops/quality.py`):
  GQ-24's note scopes the evaluated population to the *latest* completed
  run's inferential-tier decisions (superseded runs' historical
  auto_writes are detected and disclosed, never re-judged); GQ-27 now
  requires exactly one basis class per published figure and adds
  "verified" to the B5-gated vocabulary — the build-output scan finds
  0 violations over the committed corpus.
- **`sig_materialize_login` + the one-shot leg** — sqitch
  `er_rerun_login` (catalog-only, guarded): a LOGIN member of the
  NOLOGIN `sig_materialize` group, so its write surface is exactly the
  group's INSERT-only grants — write-refusal probes assert
  UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE and every claim-spine write denied, and there
  is deliberately **no** read-only session default (the grants, not a
  flag, bound it). `ops/gcp/er-rerun.sh` is the guarded leg: `--check`
  plan-only (no ADC/network); apply runs window → ADC → deps (exec SA,
  `sig-er-rerun-password` secret, sig-api serving the pinned v3-interim
  digest) → **AR-2 on-demand backup verified SUCCESSFUL** →
  exactly-once guard (an existing `ruleset_version='3-interim'` run
  exits 42) → `SIG_ER_RERUN_AUTHOR`-stamped exec-host job with the
  password minted into Secret Manager only (env, never a file).
  Rollback is forward-only — a superseding run or a PITR comparison;
  never an UPDATE/DELETE.
- **IAM + config** — `sig-er-rerun-password`'s only accessor is the exec
  host's runtime identity; `ops/exec_host.toml` +
  `ops/gcp/{config,db-logins}.sh` + `ops/src/ops/db_logins.py`
  declarations and role aliases.
- **ADR-206** — the re-run login + one-shot v3-interim leg decision;
  ADR-202 gains its appended Extended-by-ADR-206 status line; Appendix F
  row, ADR index, trigger register, BL-084 home, CHANGELOG; coverage
  notes stay honest (SIG-EVAL-001 `MET-ENGINEERED(D-R10-HUMAN-1)`;
  SIG-CONF-001/005 PARTIAL — the hosted leg + P35.47/P37.45 own the
  rest; SIG-EVAL-004's inferential clause satisfied → BL-059).
- **Tests** — `test_honest_evaluation_posture.py` (7), `test_er_rerun.py`

- **Layer honesty:** engineered + fixture-verified — **the ER re-run leg
  is QUEUED, never executed**: the AR-3/AR-2 window (≥ 2026-10-13T12:00Z,
  never 03:00–06:30Z, never day-6→13 batch) and the three `live:` edges
  cannot hold now; every gated path — the shell leg, the deps check, the
  author gate, the exactly-once guard — exits 42 with the re-run prompt.
  The queue keeps its one home in the RETURN PASS map (row staged in

- **No production write** was made; the S5-3 pre-authorisation was not
  exercised. No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `HG-nn` ticked, no

- **Boundary:** recorded head-bound after push via `ci-boundary.sh
  --stack` — see the run ledger's `ci:` line and
  `logs/ci-P34.45-*.json` (gitignored).

## Boundaries

Read-only everywhere except the one pre-authorised append-only leg:
the evaluator and quality checks never write; the login's surface is
the group's INSERT-only grants (no UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE, no
claim-spine write) verified by refusal probes; the credential exists
only as an env-mounted Secret Manager version consumed by the exec
host's runtime identity; human estimands are `unavailable`, never
fabricated, and no agent label is ever presented as a human one.
